why: The answer links the update (+3) and the isDone flag to the loop test in one correct sentence: the loop finishes the pass where i is a multiple of 5 and then stops at the next test. It does not trace the output values, so it is L3 rather than L2 or L4.

concepts.quote: quits after the pass where it hits a multiple of 5
concepts.why: Correct: when i is 10 the flag is set, that pass still finishes, and the next test is false, so the loop stops after 1 4 7 10.
It correctly names the update step but does not cover the start value or the i < 100 bound.
The answer says nothing about the order in which statements run.
The answer makes no claim about the loop running one pass too many or too few.
